posts.title: Let's Go Bowling Baby! After Falling Short By Inches, The Gators Made A Mile-Long Quantum Leap
posts.excerpt: It was the legs of No. 12, Aaron Philo, which carried the Gators to victory. (Photo Courtesy University of Florida (UAA)) What a night, and oh, what a way to get there — a freezing night in the Bluegrass, a third win over a top-11 ranked team this season. Florida 21, No. 11 Kentucky 14. Six wins. Bowl eligible. And the quarterback did it with his legs…
posts.author: Buddy Martin
